physical_frame_and_tolerance: Original native pixels only. Right-region writing viewed with exact90CW; bottom/frozen writing native. These are coordinate frames, not permission to equate arbitrarily rotated or mirrored graphics.

No rescale, enhancement, segmentation, OCR, retouching, invented continuation, or generated manuscript pixels. Private crops, exact transpose and contact sheets with labels strictly outside source pixels are allowed, with source-pixel proof before view.

Target route is inherited from approved source profile and corrected D11 route crosswalk. Rectangles are search windows, not pure contours. Comparison-specific binding uncertainty defers the relation without reopening D11 eligibility.

Translation, photographic texture, stroke thickness/taper and small contour/size variation may be recorded as observed handwriting variation only when all significant topology, attachment, branch/return and terminal relations remain supported. No arbitrary numeric threshold is fitted to force a match.

Bar position, terminal direction/length, relative arms, closure/opening count and narrow returns are not automatically nuisance variation. If their significance or visibility is unresolved, retain the competing observations and defer equality.
No dimension is removed to admit a common body; UNKNOWN is never a wildcard. Functional/historical roles and letter values remain UNKNOWN.

pair_outcomes.SAME_FULL_VISIBLE_FEATURE_CANDIDATE: New positive graphical edge only: paired concrete observations and source locators for all8 fields, complete target/context references for both IDs, both separate AI readers support plus final separate AI source checking on same original pixels. No cipher identity.
pair_outcomes.DIFFERENT_GRAPHICS: Requires paired positive source observations of a significant incompatible feature with actual local locators and adequate visibility. Text inequality, category labels, nonmembership, or absence of a match cannot supply it. Not a cryptanalytic cannot-link.
pair_outcomes.DEFERRED_FEATURE_OR_BINDING: Specific comparison-specific unresolved invariant, visibility, target or tolerated-variation conflict, with underlying observations preserved.
pair_outcomes.DEFERRED_PRESCREEN: Not directly source compared. Text/metadata priority only; never a negative graphical decision.
pair_outcomes.INHERITED_POSITIVE: One of11 previously supported old-old edges, identified separately and not counted as new source comparison.

reader_process: Two separate AI readers freeze initial source judgments before seeing each other's outcomes. Shared approved profile metadata is disclosed conditioning, not fully independent-source evidence.

Each direct pair review identifies both actual routes and all8 observed feature relations; per-unit evidence may be reused but combinatorially generated rows must not be misrepresented as direct visual pair inspections.
Disagreements are retained. Any feedback corrections are separate immutable addenda and not initial blind agreement. Source exactness alone does not establish target identity.

All930 required unordered pairs have one explicit disposition and coverage status, without duplicate IDs or hidden omitted candidates. Prescreen-only coverage cannot be called exhaustive graphical comparison.
closure_rule: Only a missing old-old edge necessary to a proposed comparison set already supported through a newly recovered member may enter closure review. BEFORE viewing that missing pair, log its two IDs, triggering new member and proposed set, existing edge witnesses, and why needed. Apply identical8feature/two-reader/final-AI gates. Inherited11 are reused. No unrelated exhaustive old55 comparison.
groups_rule: Direct-positive graph is primary. Every released repeat set must be an internally complete clique with explicit evidence for each pair. No transitive or exemplar-only expansion. Maximal cliques may overlap; memberships remain sets and do not force an alphabet partition. Distinct labels and ungrouped eligible profiles do not prove different symbols.
spatial_output: Account for all307 immutable annotation references in their inherited geometric regions, with source geometry and repeat-edge/membership references. Do not create a single definitive global text string.
Separate inherited display rank from supported geometric precedence; numeric IDs and source arrays are not reading order. No cross-region reading links without source-grounded evidence.

Right regions use increasing horizontal coordinate in90CW (decreasing nativey); bottom uses native horizontal layout. Interval overlap/approximation and frozen overlay conflicts remain explicit. A deterministic display sort alone proves no precedence.

135 unresolved records retain original boundaries/internal status and UNKNOWN_LENGTH, never one invented unknown glyph each.102 excluded whole profiles use UNKNOWN_FULL_FEATURE_LABEL and cipher-unit identity UNKNOWN. Eligible but ungrouped occurrences have UNKNOWN_REPEAT_EQUIVALENCE, not distinct alphabet symbols.

Potential aliases/overlapping annotation envelopes are explicit relations, not duplicated assumed glyphs. Unknown gaps are not declared blank, separators or additional units. Full map accounting is not exhaustive ink segmentation.
same_type_optional_recovery_rule: No outside eligibility scan. Only if a direct comparison exposes a concrete additional case with the SAME verified locator/neighbor-path error as D11, prelog that ID and exact source witness, inherited blockers and before state. A new source-only sidecar needs complete8feature/mark/old-ID/alias gates plus two readers and finalAI review; any other blocker keeps exclusion. Do not broaden to new ambiguity types or rerun finished15. Default all102/135 statuses unchanged.
completion_and_limits: Complete930 pair accounting, accepted new positives and any triggered closure edges; each released clique certified; all307 references/unknown statuses preserved in spatial output.

No minimum match count or class count. Publish only a substantive new source-supported relation or useful, validated spatial-repeat result; avoid redundant reports or new research to enlarge this pass.

Bounded stop permits explicit deferred comparisons where the frozen source procedure cannot distinguish alternatives. Distinguish unavailable physical information from uninspected-but-available pairs and from semantic/order uncertainty.

Report actual missing data precisely: e.g unreadable junction/end/mark attachment at named coordinates, unprovided source that could resolve it, or unavailable historical ordering/cipher-role evidence. Never call all102 irreducible.
No cards258/222, oldseven letter claims/keys, corpus/Potter, optimizer or completed control reruns. No letters without separate evidence.

publication.allowed: Own code and substantive text/metadata result, preserved previous layers, exactremoteSHA and CI.
publication.forbidden: NewPR, images, merge, deploy, correspondence; ordinary nighttime status updates.
